Photoreal studio product mockup of ONE David Craft Ale Dark Lager 330 ml bottle, photographed directly from the REAR. Portrait image, approximately 3:4. Use image 1 only as a reference for the centered rear-view composition, warm light cream backdrop, gentle shadow to the right, golden crimped crown cap and fine condensation. Show the complete bottle from crown to base, with small breathing room and clean warm background. Image 2 is the original front of this specific bottle: preserve its silhouette, scale and proportions, deep brown-black glass, still with amber highlights, crown, and the EXACT tall neck label height and position. Critical: the rear collar is a full-height tapered paper wrap about 21% of the complete bottle height (roughly from 10% to 31% down the bottle from the cap top), wider at the bottom, with subtly shaped and curved upper and lower edges matching the original die cut. It wraps to the far edges of the neck without covering background. espresso-black paper with copper and muted cream double rules. On its rear face show just one small centered eight-point star, like image 1. Do not use the thin ribbon from image 1. No front-facing mascot or front text.
Image 3 is the complete FINAL REAR BODY LABEL ARTWORK, to be transferred as a precise printed decal. Use the exact uploaded layout and type, not the body label in image 1. Map image 3 onto the curved glass with very mild cylindrical shading and edge compression, preserving its entire frame, shape, lettering, barcode, and all copy with no re-typesetting, cropping or text invention. Key correct text: DAVID CRAFT ALE, DARK LAGER, 330 ml, 5.0% ALC./VOL. · IBU 22. The rear label fills about 85% of the bottle body width and approximately 40% of the full bottle height, centered on the straight body with bare glass visible beneath it. Keep brand copy sharp. Matte paper contrasts with wet glass. Match the reference's gentle light, not dramatic editorial lighting. One bottle only. No interface elements, front view, extra marks, props or captions.
